item.title: Un tiroteo masivo deja nueve muertos en Erie, en Estados Unidos
item.description: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades confirmaron la muerte de nueve personas en Erie, en el estado de Pensilvania, en Estados Unidos, tras lo que el gobernador Josh Shapiro calificó como un "trágico tiroteo masivo". El incidente tuvo lugar a última hora del viernes y los investigadores determinaron que todas las muertes ocurrieron antes de que los agentes llegaran al lugar de los hechos, según un comunicado del Ayuntamiento de Erie el sábado. "He hablado con la alcaldesa Devlin y le he ofrecido todo el apoyo de mi gobierno tras el trágico tiroteo masivo ocurrido anoche en Erie, en el que perdieron la vida nueve de nuestros conciudadanos de Pensilvania", escribió Shapiro en una publicación del sábado por la mañana en X, refiriéndose a la alcaldesa Daria Devlin. El jefe de policía de Erie, Rick Lorah, dijo en un comunicado tras el tiroteo que la escena era una de las más difíciles a las que se había enfrentado durante su gestion. "La pérdida de vidas humanas es devastadora, y las circunstancias a las que nos enfrentamos son profundamente inquietantes", agregó. Lorah añadió que las autoridades seguían trabajando para determinar el motivo. El ayuntamiento indicó que estaba prevista una rueda de prensa para el sábado.

item.title: リヤド空港に再び攻撃、複数負傷し閉鎖 トランプ氏対フーシ派参戦「検討」
item.description:
Timour Azhari Enas Alashray
［リヤド １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Enas Alashray

［リヤド　１０日　ロイター］ -  サウジアラビアの首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港が１０日、攻撃され、民間航空総局によると、複数が負傷し、空港は離発着を停止した。

現時点で犯行声明は出ていない。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は、サウジが支援するイエメン暫定政府が今月、同派への大規模軍事作戦を始めたことを受け、サウジ領空を軍事作戦地域と宣言し、旅客機に同空域を避けるよう警告している。

同空港は今週既に２度攻撃を受け、４人が死亡している。１０日の攻撃の前に、サウジの早期警戒システムは警報を出しておらず、防衛能力の脆弱性が改めて浮き彫りになった。

１０日に空港にいた目撃者によると、爆発が起き、その後、屋内で複数の人が負傷して倒れていた。

負傷した旅行者はロイターに対し、空港の外の上空を何かが飛んでいくのを見た後、出発ゲート付近の天井の一部が崩落したと語った。

＜トランプ米大統領、対フーシ派攻撃参加「検討」＞

攻撃後、トランプ米大統領はホワイトハウスの外で記者団の取材に応じた。米国がサウジによるフーシ派への攻撃に加わる計画があるかと問われ、「そうするかもしれない。検討する。最新の攻撃について知ったばかりだ。決定を下すことになる。われわれは非常に迅速に動く」と述べた。

在リヤド米大使館は「攻撃を把握している」とし、「全ての米国民に対し、同空港と周辺地域を避けるよう強く勧告する」と表明した。

在サウジの英国大使館とアイルランド大使館もＸへの投稿で、同空港での「重大な事案」を把握していると明らかにした。カナダ大使館は「進行中の軍事活動」が空港の運営に影響を及ぼしていると説明した。

＜リヤドで大型国際会議＞

航空機追跡サイト「フライトレーダー２４」によると、リヤド行きの全便が目的地変更か欠航となった。

エティハド航空とカタール航空は、それぞれの拠点空港とリヤドを結ぶ複数の便を欠航にした。一部の欠航は１２日まで続く。

クウェート航空も、リヤド空港が「治安情勢」を理由に閉鎖されたとして、リヤド発着便を欠航にしたと発表した。

リヤドでは今月、世界石油会議（ＷＰＣ）とサウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、パブリック・インベストメント・ファンド（ＰＩＦ）が主導する国際金融会議 「未来投資イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」が開かれる。両会議の主催者は１０日、予定通り開催すると表明し、参加者に安全確保を約束した。

item.title: Bruins score 3 goals in final period, keep Flyers winless
item.description: Fraser Minten's second goal of the season capped a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Fraser Minten's second goal of the season capped a three-goal third period for the Boston Bruins in a 5-1 win over the visiting Philadelphia Flyers on Saturday afternoon. Pavel Zacha and Mason Lohrei scored to give Boston leads after the first two periods before the emphatic finish. Marat Khusnutdinov and Casey Mittelstadt also lit the lamp, while JJ Peterka also had two assists. Jeremy Swayman made 14 saves en route to the Bruins' second straight win and fourth through their first six games. Boston finished with a 32-15 shots on goal advantage. Porter Martone scored a power-play goal and Dan Vladar (27 saves) took the loss for Philadelphia, which remains winless at 0-4-2 on the season. The Flyers were missing forward Travis Konecny (lower-body) and defenseman Cam York (upper-body) due to day-to-day injuries. Zacha's first goal of the season at the 12:24 mark punctuated a dominant opening period in which Boston held a 12-3 edge in shots, including holding Philadelphia without a chance during its first power play. Less than one minute after the Bruins completed a solid kill, David Pastrnak moved into the zone off a turnover at the blue line dropped a backhand pass for Zacha, whose shot from the high slot leaked through Vladar and dribbled over the goal line for the opening tally. The visitors went without a shot for more than half of the second period, but Swayman stood up to the task of Porter Martone's driving backhander with 9:51 to go. Lohrei doubled Boston's lead with 2:48 left in the middle frame. After Swayman's save on a David Jiricek point shot created an odd-man rush, Minten started the play and Peterka fed the trailing defenseman for a top-shelf wrister coming to the top of the circles. The Bruins needed only 1:55 of third-period time to make it a 3-0 game, as Khusnutdinov slammed home Minten's pass from behind the net following a crisp sequence between the duo and defenseman Will Borgen. Martone broke the shutout at 6:32, placing a tight-angle wrister from the left circle upstairs on Swayman. At 9:21, Boston regained its three-goal advantage after Casey Mittelstadt joined Lohrei with a second goal in as many games. After James Hagens had an initial shot saved by Vladar, he made a diagonal pass to Elias Lindholm in the bottom of the right circle, and Mittelstadt buried it in front. Minten put the exclamation point on the victory with 4:01 to go, speeding past a defender and down the left side to slip a quick shot five-hole on Vladar. --Field Level Media

item.title: Spurs show fight as United's struggles deepen at Old Trafford
item.description: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: While Tottenham Hotspur have plenty to rue amid a difficult opening to the season, manager Roberto De Zerbi saw something at Old Trafford on Saturday that gave him reason to believe his struggling side may finally be turning a corner. Spurs are 18th and without a victory after six Premier League games following Saturday's 1-1 draw at Manchester United, yet De Zerbi was heartened by the fight his team showed to thoroughly dominate the game and then snatch a stoppage-time equaliser through Dominic Solanke despite being reduced to 10 men. "I am very happy because I have seen the right spirit and character," De Zerbi told Sky Sports. Bryan Mbeumo scored against the run of play before Tottenham's Rodrigo Bentancur was sent off for head-butting Luke Shaw, leaving United fans daring to dream of a much-needed victory, only for Solanke's 92nd-minute header to puncture the mood at Old Trafford. "We suffered in the game. I like the situation we were in with the red card. We need this situation. We have not accepted the defeat. We have to react in all ways we can," De Zerbi said. Rather than fold, Tottenham fought until Solanke headed the equaliser in stoppage time, giving De Zerbi's side more to celebrate than their hosts despite their lowly league position. Spurs, who spent more than £300 million ($397 million) in the transfer market during the close season, have failed to win any of their opening six league matches for only the fourth time in the club's history. Their manager, however, believes there were signs against United that his ideas are beginning to take hold. "We have to believe in ourselves and this football way," De Zerbi said. "If we believe, improve and play as a team, we will score many goals and win many games. If we don't play as a team, it is impossible." For United, there was less cause for optimism. Michael Carrick's side have collected only six points from their first six games, their poorest start to a league campaign since 1986-87, when they had four at the same stage. United struggled desperately before taking the lead through Mbeumo. But even with a man advantage, they failed to put away a Tottenham team that had started the day bottom of the table. "We were mixed (in performance)," Carrick said. "We found it tough first half, it was a challenging first half for us and you could see it just wasn't quite there, it wasn't clicking." The Reds are also winless in the last three league matches when their opponent has had a red card. Carrick was particularly frustrated at allowing Tottenham back into the game that appeared to be United's for the taking. "It's a game we should kill off. And we didn't," he said. "Very disappointed to be in a position like that and not come away with the game." ($1 = 0.7558 pounds)

item.title: 茂木外相がルビオ米国務長官と電話会談、ＩＣＣ制裁で「意思疎通を継続」
item.description:
Tamiyuki Kihara
［東京／ワシントン １０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tamiyuki Kihara

［東京／ワシントン　１０日　ロイター］ - 茂木敏充外相は１０日夜、米国のルビオ国務長官と電話会談し、トランプ米政権が国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）本体に制裁措置を科したことについて、緊密に意思疎通を継続することで一致した。茂木氏はこれに先立ち、ＩＣＣの赤根智子所長とも電話で会談した。

日本外務省によると、茂木氏はＩＣＣについてルビオ氏に「これまで表明している日本の立場」（外務省関係者）を改めて伝達。両氏は緊密に意思疎通を継続していくことで一致した。厳しい安全保障環境の中で日米同盟をさらに強固なものにし、幅広く協力を進めていくために引き続き取り組むことも確認した。

このほか、沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件で米兵が逮捕されたことについても「事件の発生防止のために実効性のある措置を取るべく、日米間で協議していくこと」を確認した。赤根氏との電話会談では、ＩＣＣを巡る現下の状況などについて意見交換したという。

米国務省は声明で、日米外相が電話会談で、ＩＣＣへの制裁や３０─３１日に米アトランタで開催される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合などについて意見交換したと発表した。沖縄県で発生した強盗殺人事件については、 「ルビオ氏は沖縄での日本国民の死去に心からの哀悼の意を示すとともに、日本政府と地元当局が捜査を進めるに当たり、連絡を取り合い全面的に協力するという米国の決意を伝えた」とした。

日本や英国など複数の欧州諸国、カナダの外相は９日、トランプ米政権がＩＣＣ本体に制裁措置を科したことを受け、「制裁が実施されれば、ＩＣＣの活動、献身的な職員、その家族に重大な影響を及ぼすことになる」などとする共同声明を発表した。

高市早苗首相も同日夜、米国の制裁が「日本の立場と相容れるものではなく、深く懸念している」と自身のソーシャルメディア「Ｘ」に投稿。「我が国は国際社会における法の支配を一貫して重視し、その役割を担うＩＣＣを支持している」とも改めて表明した。

ノルウェーに本拠地を置くノーベル賞委員会は同日、ＩＣＣで判事を務めたナビ・ピレイ氏にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。これを受け、トランプ米大統領は自身が受賞できなかったことに不満を表明。恥ずべき不名誉な決定でノルウェーに汚点を残したなどと批判していた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：平田紀之）

item.title: El huracán Isaías se cobra cuatro vidas y deja a unos 670.000 personas sin electricidad en EEUU
item.description: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Rhea Abraham, Rajveer Pardesi, Marianna Parraga
item.content:encoded: Cuatro personas fallecieron tras la llegada del huracán Isaías a primera hora del sábado, y unos 670.000 habitantes de Florida, Alabama, Georgia y Misisipi seguían sin suministro eléctrico cuando la tormenta se debilitó hasta convertirse en un ciclón postropical, según autoridades locales y los servicios de seguimiento del suministro eléctrico en Estados Unidos. Dos de las muertes se debieron a la caída de árboles sobre viviendas, según medios de comunicación locales y las autoridades. Las autoridades de Florida no habían recibido ninguna solicitud de búsqueda y rescate poco después de que la tormenta tocó tierra, lo que indica que el impacto fue limitado, dijo el gobernador Ron DeSantis. Sin embargo, seguían existiendo condiciones peligrosas y se esperaban marejadas ciclónicas, inundaciones repentinas, vientos destructivos y riesgo de tornados en algunas zonas del sureste de Estados Unidos, según el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH). Se prevé que la amenaza de tornados continúe el sábado en algunas zonas del Panhandle de Florida, Georgia y las Carolinas, según el NHC. Otra tormenta en el océano Pacífico, "Rachel", se desplazaba el sábado hacia la costa del norte de Baja California, provocando ráfagas de viento y mareas más altas, lo que dejó a otras 7.000 personas sin electricidad en California. Isaías, un huracán de categoría 2 cuando tocó tierra en la costa de Florida y el primero de la temporada atlántica de 2026, se espera que genere rachas de viento en el interior antes de debilitarse por debajo de la fuerza de vendaval más tarde el sábado, según el CNH. Alrededor del 69% de la producción de petróleo y el 57% de la de gas natural en el golfo de México estadounidense seguían paralizados el sábado, lo que supone un ligero descenso con respecto a las cifras del viernes, según la Administración de Minerales Marinos. Unas 113 plataformas de producción, que representan el 30% del total, seguían evacuadas, según la agencia.

item.title: Nvidia in talks to invest further in Reflection AI or buy it, FT reports
item.description: Nvidia is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) is in talks to deepen its investment in open-source startup Reflection AI or acquire it, the Financial Times reported on Saturday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter. Talks are at an early stage and a deal could take several forms, including a so-called acqui-hire arrangement where Nvidia would hire staff and license technology rather than pursue a full acquisition, potentially avoiding a lengthy regulatory review, the newspaper said. An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, according to the report, which cited multiple people familiar with the matter, while adding that the discussions could still fall apart. Reflection declined to comment on the FT report, while Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Nvidia is already a major financial backer and strategic investor in Reflection AI, having invested $800 million in the startup, the FT reported. Founded in 2024 by former DeepMind researchers Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou, Reflection develops tools that automate software development, a fast-growing use case for AI. Reflection's chief executive, Laskin, told CNBC in April that the Nvidia-backed startup was raising fresh capital at a pre-money valuation of [USN:FWN4160Z3 TEXT:"$25 billion"]. The company on Monday launched its first open-weight model, [USN:L4N45R19C TEXT:"Beam,"] as it seeks to compete in coding and agentic tasks with lower-cost Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Kimi.

item.title: Report: Sam Fuld declines offer to head Athletics' front office
item.description: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Athletics will continue their search for a president of baseball operations after Sam Fuld declined an offer for the position, ESPN reported Saturday. Fuld is the current president of business operations for the Philadelphia Phillies and will reportedly remain in the same job. Currently playing home games in Sacramento, Calif., the A's are scheduled to move into a stadium currently under construction in Las Vegas for the 2028 season. The A's fired general manager David Forst in August as the team limped to a 64-98 record. The franchise last had a winning season in 2021 and last made the playoffs in 2020, when the club advanced to the American League Division Series. According to ESPN, Boston Red Sox assistant general manager Taylor Smith is a top candidate to take over as A's president of baseball operations. --Field Level Media

item.title: Colts DE Arden Key (hamstring) lands on injured reserve
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indianapolis Colts placed defensive end Arden Key on injured reserve Saturday with a hamstring injury. Key sustained the injury during Indianapolis' 30-13 victory over the Washington Commanders last Sunday in London. Key, 30, has recorded eight combined tackles, one forced fumble, 0.5 sacks and three quarterback hits in four starts in his first season with Indianapolis (2-2). He signed as a free agent in March. Key has 200 combined tackles, 31 sacks, 39 tackles for loss, five forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries in 120 regular-season games (50 starts) for the Oakland/Las Vegas Raiders (2018-20), San Francisco 49ers (2021), Jacksonville Jaguars (2022), Tennessee Titans (2023-25) and Colts. The Raiders selected Key in the third round of the 2018 NFL Draft out of LSU. Also on Saturday, the Colts elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad to the active roster. He has appeared in two other games this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: FBI awarding UFC exclusive agreement to train agents
item.description: The FBI intends to award the UFC an exclusive contract to train agents in hand-to-hand combat, according to The Athletic.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The FBI intends to award the UFC an exclusive contract to train agents in hand-to-hand combat, according to The Athletic. The report cites a "Sole Source Justification" document filed on September 30th. The form enables the government to award a contract without reviewing bids from competitors. "The FBI requires a training program for special agents in defense tactical techniques that focus on integrating mixed martial arts (MMA) skills with specialized defense tactics," the document stated. "The purpose of the training is to enhance physical combat abilities, mental toughness, and tactical awareness, which are crucial for special agents in high-risk situations." The document proposes a one-year, exclusive contract. The financial amount would be redacted. The UFC and its CEO and president Dana White have working relationship with the Trump administration. The White House hosted UFC Freedom 250 in June. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rússia flexibiliza proibição às exportações de diesel após acordo entre Putin e Trump
item.description: O governo russo anunciou no sábado que havia suspendido parcialmente a proibição das exportações de diesel, com efeito imediato, após um acordo entre o presidente Vladimir Putin e o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, para que a Rússia abasteça os mercados dos EUA e do mundo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O governo russo anunciou no sábado que havia suspendido parcialmente a proibição das exportações de diesel, com efeito imediato, após um acordo entre o presidente Vladimir Putin e o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, para que a Rússia abasteça os mercados dos EUA e do mundo. “Os volumes de produção são suficientes para atender integralmente tanto à demanda interna quanto às exportações para o mercado mundial nos volumes especificados”, afirmou o vice-primeiro-ministro Alexander Novak em comunicado.

item.title: Rubio pledges US cooperation in Okinawa murder case
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Saturday vowed to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a US Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa, a case that sparked protests and prompted a US military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Saturday vowed to cooperate with Japanese authorities investigating allegations that a US Marine murdered a woman in Okinawa, a case that sparked [USN:L6N45U0MC TEXT:"protests"] and prompted a US military curfew and mandatory training in standards and discipline. The top US diplomat spoke with Japanese Foreign Minister Motegi Toshimitsu in a phone call, the US Department of State said in a statement following the death of a local woman in a hotel that has renewed tensions over the US military presence. "Rubio expressed sincere condolences over the death of a Japanese national in Okinawa, as well as the United States’ determination to communicate and fully cooperate with the Government of Japan and local authorities as they conduct an investigation," the department said. Devin Jacob Ballard, stationed at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, was [USN:L1N45Q00F TEXT:"arrested"] on October 4 on suspicion of robbing and murdering Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel in the capital Naha, according to local police. Ballard has denied the allegations. US military personnel stationed on Okinawa have been given a month-long [USN:L1N45T08D TEXT:"curfew and banned from drinking"] alcohol while they undergo discipline training following the incident. Japan hosts the largest overseas contingent of US forces globally, with most of the 18,000 Japan-based Marines stationed on Okinawa. Rubio and Toshimitsu also discussed US sanctions on the International Criminal Court and the upcoming G20 Foreign Ministers gathering in Atlanta scheduled to begin October 30.

item.title: Barcelona cruise past Getafe to maintain perfect start
item.description: Barcelona extended their perfect start to the LaLiga season with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday, making it eight wins from eight matches and maintaining their lead at the top of the table.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Barcelona extended their perfect start to the LaLiga season with a comfortable 3-0 home win over Getafe on Saturday, making it eight wins from eight matches and maintaining their lead at the top of the table. The three-week international break did little to disrupt Barcelona’s rhythm and they went ahead after two minutes when Anthony Gordon cut inside and saw his shot deflect off Mario Martin and beyond goalkeeper David Soria. Getafe struggled to escape their own half under sustained pressure and Gabriel Jesus punished a giveaway by Zaid Romero to score on his first start for Barcelona. The hosts remained firmly in control after the break, with Getafe testing Joan Garcia only once on the goalkeeper’s return from injury. Jules Kounde, who had missed a clear chance in the first half, completed the scoring in the 73rd minute with a simple finish from Lamine Yamal’s curling cross. Barcelona lead the standings with 24 points, five ahead of Atletico Madrid and nine clear of Real Madrid, who host Villarreal later on Saturday.

item.title: Índia detém milhares e tenta barrar protesto contra chefe da comissão eleitoral
item.description: A polícia deteve mais de 2.000 manifestantes e o fundador do movimento juvenil “Cockroach” em Délhi no sábado, enquanto as forças de segurança isolavam partes da capital para impedir uma manifestação que exigia a renúncia do chefe eleitoral da Índia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia deteve mais de 2.000 manifestantes e o fundador do movimento juvenil “Cockroach” em Délhi no sábado, enquanto as forças de segurança isolavam partes da capital para impedir uma manifestação que exigia a renúncia do chefe eleitoral da Índia. Milhares de policiais e membros de forças paramilitares foram mobilizados por toda a cidade, os serviços de internet móvel foram suspensos no distrito comercial central e dezenas de estações de metrô e mercados foram fechados, enquanto as autoridades agiam para impedir uma manifestação organizada pelo movimento Cockroach. O protesto tinha como alvo o presidente da Comissão Eleitoral, Gyanesh Kumar, devido a uma revisão das listas eleitorais que, segundo os críticos, beneficia desproporcionalmente o Partido Bharatiya Janata (BJP), do primeiro-ministro Narendra Modi, atualmente no poder. O movimento havia planejado reunir milhares de pessoas em Jantar Mantar, no centro de Délhi, mas a área foi isolada pelas forças de segurança antes do início da manifestação. Um funcionário do Ministério do Interior, que falou sob condição de anonimato, disse à Reuters que mais de 2.000 pessoas foram detidas em Délhi. A mídia local informou que cerca de 400 manifestantes foram detidos no centro financeiro da Índia, em Mumbai. Não houve comentário imediato da polícia sobre as detenções. Pequenos protestos eclodiram em outros pontos de Délhi, inclusive em um popular mercado de artesanato e no memorial ao líder do movimento pela liberdade, Mahatma Gandhi, com manifestantes exigindo a renúncia de Kumar. “Viva a revolução”, gritavam alguns jovens manifestantes enquanto a polícia os perseguia e arrastava dezenas de outros para dentro de ônibus para levá-los embora, mesmo com a chegada de mais pessoas, relatou uma testemunha da Reuters. “Isso está violando os direitos do povo e o país não vai mais tolerar isso”, disse Yogendra Solanki à Reuters enquanto a polícia o escoltava para longe. A polícia deteve o fundador do partido Cockroach Janta, Abhijeet Dipke, e os líderes seniores Saurav Das e Ashutosh Ranka quando o voo deles, proveniente de Mumbai, pousou em Délhi, informou o grupo em comunicado. Representantes de dois veículos de notícias digitais afirmaram que a polícia deteve brevemente quatro de seus repórteres enquanto cobriam as manifestações. Um jornalista da Reuters também foi detido por um breve período antes de ser liberado.

item.title: USA-La survivante d'une tentative d'exécution quitte l'hôpital et retourne en prison
item.description: Christa Pike, la condamnée à mort dont l'exécution a échoué la semaine dernière dans le Tennessee, est sortie samedi de l'hôpital pour être renvoyée en prison où elle continuera de recevoir des soins médicaux, ont indiqué ses avocats.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Christa Pike, la condamnée à mort dont l'exécution a échoué la semaine dernière dans le Tennessee, est sortie samedi de l'hôpital pour être renvoyée en prison où elle continuera de recevoir des soins médicaux, ont indiqué ses avocats. Christa Pike a regagné le centre Debra K. Johnson où elle est incarcérée depuis plus de 30 ans, ont-ils précisé dans un communiqué. Condamnée à mort pour un meurtre commis en 1995, Christa Pike s'est réveillée "en colère et désorientée" à l'hôpital cette semaine avec une longue convalescence devant elle après avoir survécu à la tentative d'exécution du 30 septembre, avaient indiqué ses avocats mercredi, alors qu'ils estimaient auparavant qu'elle pouvait être en état de mort cérébrale. Christa Pike, âgée de 50 ans, avait été transférée de la chambre d'exécution vers un hôpital de Nashville, inconsciente, dans un état critique et présentant de graves blessures aux bras, après l'échec de deux injections létales à la prison de haute sécurité de Riverbend. Un juge du Tennessee a ordonné cette semaine aux autorités de l'État de conserver toutes les preuves liées à cette tentative d'exécution ratée, une décision que l'un des avocats de la condamnée à mort a qualifiée de "première d'une longue série de mesures visant à préserver et à faire respecter ses droits constitutionnels". Le gouverneur du Tennessee a suspendu toutes les exécutions jusqu'à la fin de l'année, le temps que les enquêteurs se penchent sur l'exécution ratée de Christa Pike et sur un échec similaire datant du mois de mai.

item.title: Jessica Korda welcomes baby girl: 'No longer outnumbered'
item.description: Jessica Korda is proud to be a "girl mom."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jessica Korda is proud to be a "girl mom." The LPGA golfer and husband Johnny DelPrete recently announced the birth of their second child, Olivia Regina DelPrete. The middle name carries a special family significance as it honors Jessica's mother, Regina Korda, a former tennis player and Olympian who represented Czechoslovakia at the 1988 Summer Games in Seoul. "Mom is no longer outnumbered," Korda wrote in her Instagram post. Olivia joins Korda's first child, Greyson John DelPrete, who was born in February 2024. "AND IM A GIRL AUNTIE," Nelly Korda wrote in the comments on Jessica's post. "SHES A GIRL MOM" Jessica Korda, 33, has won six times on the LPGA Tour. Her most recent victory was at the Diamond Resorts Tournament of Champions in January 2021. --Field Level Media

item.title: Sobrevivente de execução no Tennessee recebe alta do hospital e volta para prisão
item.description: A condenada à morte Christa Pike recebeu alta de um hospital nos EUA neste sábado e foi levada de volta à prisão, onde continuará recebendo cuidados médicos após a tentativa fracassada de execução no Tennessee, informaram seus advogados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A condenada à morte Christa Pike recebeu alta de um hospital nos EUA neste sábado e foi levada de volta à prisão, onde continuará recebendo cuidados médicos após a tentativa fracassada de execução no Tennessee, informaram seus advogados. Pike recebeu alta de um hospital local e agora se encontra no Centro de Reabilitação Debra K. Johnson, onde está há mais de 30 anos, afirmaram os advogados Stephen Ferrell e Luke Ihnen, do Serviço de Defensoria Federal do Leste do Tennessee, e Randy Spivey e Kelly Gleason, do Escritório de Defensoria Pós-Condenação do Tennessee, em um comunicado conjunto. Pike, condenada à morte por um homicídio ocorrido em 1995, acordou “irritada e confusa” no hospital nesta semana, com um longo processo de recuperação pela frente após ter sobrevivido à tentativa de execução em 30 de setembro, informaram seus advogados na quarta-feira. Anteriormente, eles acreditavam que ela pudesse estar em morte cerebral. Pike, de 50 anos, havia sido levada da câmara de execução para um hospital em Nashville, inconsciente, em estado crítico e com ferimentos graves nos braços, depois que duas injeções não conseguiram matá-la na Instituição de Segurança Máxima de Riverbend. Um juiz do Tennessee ordenou nesta semana que as autoridades estaduais preservassem todas as provas relacionadas à tentativa fracassada de executá-la, um desdobramento que um de seus advogados chamou de “o primeiro de muitos passos para preservar e fazer valer seus direitos constitucionais”. O governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, suspendeu todas as execuções pelo resto do ano enquanto investigadores analisam a execução mal sucedida de Pike e um caso semelhante envolvendo Tony Carruthers em maio, quando os agentes penitenciários não conseguiram instalar as linhas intravenosas.

item.title: Trump dice que a Zelenski "más le vale dejar" de atacar refinerías rusas, pide un nuevo líder
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, pidió este sábado un nuevo liderazgo en Ucrania y arremetió contra el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski, a quien instó a dejar de atacar las refinerías de petróleo rusas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, pidió este sábado un nuevo liderazgo en Ucrania y arremetió contra el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski, a quien instó a dejar de atacar las refinerías de petróleo rusas. "Más le vale que pare de una vez", dijo Trump a periodistas en la Casa Blanca, un día después de anunciar que había llegado a un acuerdo que permitía a Rusia suministrar diésel a los mercados mundiales. "Les sugiero que busquen un nuevo líder capaz de llegar a un acuerdo", dijo, refiriéndose a Zelenski.

item.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike released from hospital, returned to prison
item.description: Death row inmate Christa Pike was released from a US hospital on Saturday and sent back to prison where she will continue receiving medical care following her botched execution attempt in Tennessee, her attorneys said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Death row inmate Christa Pike was released from a US hospital on Saturday and sent back to prison where she will continue receiving medical care following her [USN:L1N45M031 TEXT:"botched execution attempt in Tennessee"], her attorneys said. Pike was discharged from a local hospital and is now at the Debra K. Johnson Rehabilitation Center, where she has been housed for more than 30 years, said attorneys Stephen Ferrell and Luke Ihnen from Federal Defender Services of Eastern Tennessee, and Randy Spivey and Kelly Gleason from the Tennessee Office of the Post Conviction Defender in a joint release. Pike, sentenced to death for a 1995 murder, awoke "angry and confused" in the hospital this week with a long recuperation ahead after surviving the attempted execution on September 30, her lawyers said on Wednesday. They previously believed she could be brain-dead. Pike, 50, had been taken from the execution chamber to a Nashville hospital, unconscious, critically ill and with severe arm injuries after two injections failed to kill her at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution. A Tennessee judge this week [USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"ordered"] state officials to preserve all evidence related to their failed attempt to execute her, a development one of [USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"her lawyers"] called the "first of many steps to preserve and enforce her constitutional rights." Tennessee Governor Bill Lee suspended all executions for the rest of the year while investigators look in to the botched execution of Pike and a similar failure involving Tony Carruthers in May, when prison officials were unable to set up intravenous lines.

item.title: Man United fans revive ticker taunt over Man City financial case
item.description: Manchester United fans revived one of English football's most famous banners on Saturday to taunt Manchester City amid their rival's battle with the Premier League over more than 100 alleged breaches of financial rules.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Manchester United fans revived one of English football's most famous banners on Saturday to taunt Manchester City amid their rival's battle with the Premier League over more than 100 alleged [USN:L6N45L10G TEXT:"breaches"] of financial rules. A banner bearing the words "51 YEARS" was unfurled in the Stretford End during United's Premier League game against Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday. By displaying the figure, United supporters sought to suggest that any trophies won by City between 2009 and 2018 -- which form the core of the Premier League's case against the club -- should not count, effectively extending their wait for silverware back to their 1976 League Cup success. The banner echoed the "24 YEARS" sign first displayed by United fans in 2000, highlighting City's then two-decade-plus trophy drought. The number was increased annually as City endured a barren spell and eventually reached 35. The banner disappeared after City lifted the FA Cup in 2011, their first major trophy since 1976, before they went on to win multiple Premier League titles, domestic cups and the Champions League. City were charged by the Premier League in February 2023 with more than 100 alleged breaches of financial regulations covering a period from 2009 to 2018. [USN:L8N45V0N7 TEXT:"Enzo Maresca's"] team travel to Liverpool on Sunday in their first game since being found guilty of serious breaches of the league's financial rules. City have denied wrongdoing and lodged an appeal against the independent commission's verdict.

item.title: Guarda Revolucionária do Irã diz que petroleiro explodiu após atingir mina no Estreito de Ormuz
item.description: A Guarda Revolucionária do Irã informou neste sábado que um petroleiro explodiu e pegou fogo após colidir com uma mina naval enquanto atravessava o Estreito de Ormuz, segundo a mídia estatal iraniana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Guarda Revolucionária do Irã informou neste sábado que um petroleiro explodiu e pegou fogo após colidir com uma mina naval enquanto atravessava o Estreito de Ormuz, segundo a mídia estatal iraniana. A Guarda Revolucionária não especificou o nome nem a bandeira do petroleiro.

item.title: Nine dead in Erie, Pennsylvania, mass shooting
item.description: Nine people were confirmed dead in Erie, Pennsylvania, authorities said, after what Governor Josh Shapiro called a "tragic mass shooting."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nine people were confirmed dead in Erie, Pennsylvania, authorities said, after what Governor Josh Shapiro called a "tragic mass shooting." The incident occurred late on Friday and investigators determined that all deaths occurred before officers arrived at the scene, a statement from the city of Erie said on Saturday. "I’ve spoken with Mayor Devlin and offered my Administration’s full support following the tragic mass shooting in Erie last night — killing nine of our fellow Pennsylvanians," Shapiro wrote in a Saturday morning post on X, referring to Mayor Daria Devlin. Erie Police Chief Rick Lorah said in a statement following the shooting that the scene was one of the most difficult he has encountered during his tenure. “The loss of life is devastating, and the circumstances we are working through are deeply disturbing,” he said. Lorah added that authorities were still working to establish a motive. The city said a news conference was scheduled for Saturday.

item.title: Nove morrem em tiroteio em massa na Pensilvânia
item.description: Nove pessoas foram confirmadas como mortas em Erie, no Estado norte-americano da Pensilvânia, segundo autoridades, após o que o governador Josh Shapiro chamou de “trágico tiroteio em massa”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nove pessoas foram confirmadas como mortas em Erie, no Estado norte-americano da Pensilvânia, segundo autoridades, após o que o governador Josh Shapiro chamou de “trágico tiroteio em massa”. O incidente ocorreu na noite de sexta-feira e os investigadores determinaram que todas as mortes ocorreram antes da chegada dos policiais ao local, segundo comunicado divulgado pela prefeitura de Erie no sábado. “Conversei com o prefeito Devlin e ofereci todo o apoio do meu governo após o trágico tiroteio em massa ocorrido ontem à noite em Erie — que matou nove de nossos concidadãos da Pensilvânia”, escreveu Shapiro em uma postagem na manhã de sábado no X.

item.title: Report: Alabama TE Josh Ford to play vs. No. 2 Georgia
item.description: Alabama tight end Josh Ford is expected to play on Saturday against No. 2 Georgia in Tuscaloosa, ESPN reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alabama tight end Josh Ford is expected to play on Saturday against No. 2 Georgia in Tuscaloosa, ESPN reported. Ford underwent surgery this week to repair a broken arm, an injury sustained last Saturday in the sixth-ranked Crimson Tide's 56-23 victory over Mississippi State. A transfer from Oklahoma State, Ford reeled in his lone catch of the season for a touchdown reception in Alabama's 49-18 victory over South Carolina on Sept. 26. He is known more as a blocking tight end for the Crimson Tide (5-0, 3-0 Southeastern Conference). --Field Level Media

item.title: El huracán Simón se intensifica hasta alcanzar la categoría 4 frente a las costas de México
item.description: El huracán Simón se intensificó el sábado hasta convertirse en una potente tormenta de categoría 4 frente a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone una amenaza de vientos destructivos, marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales a medida que se aproxima a tierra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El huracán Simón se intensificó el sábado hasta convertirse en una potente tormenta de categoría 4 frente a la costa del Pacífico de México, lo que supone una amenaza de vientos destructivos, marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales a medida que se aproxima a tierra. El Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (CNH) indicó que el sábado por la mañana Simón se encontraba a unos 185 kilómetros al sur-suroeste de Manzanillo, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 240 kilómetros por hora mientras se desplazaba hacia el norte. Se prevé que Simón se acerque a la costa centro-occidental de México como un huracán de gran intensidad a última hora del sábado o a primera hora del domingo, y aún es posible que se intensifique más antes de tocar tierra, según el NHC. Se emitió una advertencia de huracán para algunas zonas de la costa pacífica de México al sur de la localidad turística de Puerto Vallarta, incluida la zona en torno a Manzanillo, el mayor puerto mexicano del Pacífico. Más al sur, hacia Lázaro Cárdenas, estaba en vigor una alerta de tormenta tropical. El CNH instó a los residentes de la zona de alerta, que también incluye el archipiélago de las Islas Marías, situado frente a la costa, a acelerar los preparativos para proteger vidas y bienes. "Simón se ha intensificado con una rapidez increíble, y eso es lo que hace que tormentas como esta sean tan peligrosas", dijo el meteorólogo de AccuWeather, Dan Pydynowski. "Los fuertes vientos podrían causar daños en viviendas y negocios, mientras que las inundaciones y los deslizamientos de tierra podrían arrasar las carreteras y dificultar el acceso de los equipos de emergencia a algunas comunidades. Incluso después de que pase la tormenta, los cortes de electricidad y los daños en las infraestructuras podrían complicar la recuperación". Las autoridades mexicanas advirtieron de que se esperaban fuertes lluvias en los estados de Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima y Jalisco. El NHC indicó que se espera que Simón provoque entre 25 a 51 centímetros de lluvia en algunas zonas del suroeste de México hasta el domingo, con precipitaciones aisladas de hasta 76 centímetros en algunas partes de Michoacán, Colima y Jalisco. Las lluvias podrían provocar inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra que pongan en peligro la vida, especialmente en zonas montañosas.

item.title: India's Infosys does not expect material impact from US PERM suspension
item.description: Infosys , India's second-largest IT firm, said on Saturday that it does not anticipate a material impact from the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) application suspension announced by the US government.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Infosys (INFY.NS) , India's second-largest IT firm, said on Saturday that it does not anticipate a material impact from the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) application suspension announced by the US government. The US government said on Thursday it was [USN:L4N45U1DA TEXT:"suspending"] some major global tech and IT firms, including Infosys, from the PERM green card program, which allows skilled foreign workers to gain permanent residency in the US through their employment. "We welcome the opportunity to work with the Department of Labor and related government agencies to answer any questions they may have," Infosys said in an exchange filing.

item.title: Rangers G Igor Shesterkin out for season with lower-body injury
item.description: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the remainder of the season due to a lower-body injury, the team announced Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin will miss the remainder of the season due to a lower-body injury, the team announced Saturday. The news comes one day after the 2021-22 Vezina Trophy winner sustained the injury during the second period of a 3-1 loss against the host Washington Capitals. Also on Saturday, the Rangers announced goaltender Joonas Korpisalo will be sidelined for the next four weeks due to a lower-body injury. Shesterkin appeared to awkwardly jam his right skate into the goalpost while sliding into position to make a save. After stopping 13 of the 14 shots he saw, Shesterkin remained down on the ice for several minutes and had to be helped to the bench by a pair of teammates without putting any pressure on his right leg. Dylan Garand, who made 22 saves in New York's 2-0 win at Detroit on Oct. 2, replaced Shesterkin. "It's awful," Rangers captain J.T. Miller said after the game Friday. "He's a pillar of this team. It stinks. Obviously, it's (early). We don't even know what's going on, but to see him leave the game is a shot to all of us, a shock to all of us. But at the same time, it means we got to step up to a man to try to get the job done, especially (Garand)." Shesterkin finishes his season with a 3-1-0 record, a 1.79 goals-against average and a .927 save percentage in five games (all starts). He is in the second season of an eight-year, $92 million contract. Shesterkin, 30, is 190-108-28 with a 2.51 GAA and .917 save percentage in 330 career games (325 starts) with the Rangers. The Rangers acquired Korpisalo from the Boston Bruins in July for forward prospect Kalle Vaisanen and a fourth-round draft pick in 2028. Korpisalo, 32, was Boston's No. 2 goaltender last season and went 14-9-6 with a 3.15 goals-against average and .894 save percentage in 29 starts. In 11 NHL seasons, Korpisalo is 140-126-38 with a 3.06 GAA and eight shutouts since entering the league in 2015. He played 7 1/2 seasons with the Columbus Blue Jackets and also has played for the Los Angeles Kings and Ottawa Senators in addition to spending the last two seasons with Boston. While with the Blue Jackets, Korpisalo made an NHL postseason record 85 saves during a five-overtime, 3-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning on Aug. 11, 2020. Korpisalo earned a bronze medal at the 2026 Olympics in Italy while playing for Finland. --Field Level Media

item.title: Alonso hails Caicedo’s impact as Chelsea crush Bournemouth
item.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: William Schomberg
item.content:encoded: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has had to wait until October to see what his side can do with midfielder Moises Caicedo properly back in the team and he was delighted with his role in the 5-1 demolition of Bournemouth in the Premier League on Saturday. Alonso – who oversaw two victories in his first two matches in charge of Chelsea before failing to win any of the next three - gave Caicedo his first start of the season after being sidelined with a calf problem. The Ecuadorian, 24, provided a stronger shield for Chelsea's defence that has looked shaky since the campaign began and he formed an effective partnership with 36 year-old Jordan Henderson who scored twice. Alonso stressed the importance of Caicedo's return after a brief appearance in August when he lasted only 14 minutes as a substitute before having to limp off. "With him we have a better midfield area and when you are better in the middle you have a more complete team and something to build around," the Spaniard told reporters. "I am so happy that Moi is feeling better because he is going to be a key player for us. We knew that and we have seen (it) today." In further encouragement for Chelsea fans, right back Marco Palestra - who signed from Atalanta in Italy in the close season but was injured soon after - made his debut as a substitute. The two goals from Henderson and another two from Joao Pedro – both players who have also been in the medical room – and a Morgan Rogers strike underscored Chelsea’s reputation as one of the Premier League’s entertainers this season. They added to their tally of early goals as they rushed into a 2-0 lead within 149 seconds and got their third a little more than 30 seconds after the start of the second half. Cole Palmer celebrated signing a contract extension by providing two assists, adding to the signs that he is getting back to top form. The only worries for Alonso were Chelsea's failure to keep a clean sheet for a 22nd Premier League game in a row when Bournemouth striker Evanilson briefly gave the visitors hope in the second half, and the absence of captain Reece James. Alonso said James - who has missed long spells in recent seasons due to hamstring problems - had suffered a knee injury in training on Friday. Chelsea will face stiffer tests this season than Bournemouth who have not won any of their six games so far under new manager Marco Rose and were missing key players including England midfielder Alex Scott and strikers Eli Kroupi and Justin Kluivert. Alonso said Chelsea lost control of the game briefly when Bournemouth pulled a goal back through Evanilson to make it 3-1 in the 51st minute, but he took encouragement from the way they finished off the game with two goals in three minutes later on. "From today we take positives for the future," he said.

item.title: Trump pede que Zelenskiy pare de atacar refinarias russas e defende novo líder na Ucrânia
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, pediu neste sábado uma nova liderança na Ucrânia, criticando duramente o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy e exortando o líder de Kiev a parar de atacar refinarias de petróleo russas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, pediu neste sábado uma nova liderança na Ucrânia, criticando duramente o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy e exortando o líder de Kiev a parar de atacar refinarias de petróleo russas. “É melhor ele parar com isso”, disse Trump a repórteres na Casa Branca, um dia depois de afirmar que havia fechado um acordo permitindo que a Rússia fornecesse diesel aos mercados globais. “Sugiro que eles escolham um novo líder capaz de fechar um acordo”, declarou ele, referindo-se a Zelenskiy.

item.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens to Category 4 off Mexico coast
item.description: Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico's west-central Pacific coast on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hurricane Simon strengthened into a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast on Saturday, threatening destructive winds, storm surges and potentially deadly flooding as it approaches landfall. The US National Hurricane Center said Simon was located about 115 miles (185 km) south-southwest of Manzanillo on Saturday morning, packing maximum sustained winds of 150 mph (240 kph) as it moved northward. Simon is expected to approach the west-central coast of Mexico as a major hurricane late Saturday or early Sunday, and some additional strengthening remains possible before landfall, the NHC said. A hurricane warning was in effect for portions of Mexico's Pacific coast south of the beach resort of Puerto Vallarta, including the area around Manzanillo, Mexico's largest Pacific port. A tropical storm watch was in effect farther south toward Lazaro Cardenas. The NHC urged residents in the warning area, which also includes the Islas Marias archipelago offshore, to rush preparations to protect life and property. “Simon has strengthened incredibly quickly, and that’s what makes storms like this so dangerous,” said AccuWeather meteorologist Dan Pydynowski. “Strong winds could damage homes and businesses, while flooding and mudslides could wash out roads and make it difficult for emergency crews to reach some communities. Even after the storm passes, power outages and damaged infrastructure could make recovery challenging.” Mexican authorities warned that heavy rainfall was expected in the states of Guerrero, Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The NHC said Simon was expected to produce 10 to 20 inches (25 to 51 cm) of rain across portions of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 30 inches (76 cm) possible in parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas. A storm surge is expected along the coast near and to the east of where the center makes landfall, accompanied by large and destructive waves, the NHC said. Swells generated by Simon are expected to affect portions of Mexico's southwestern and west-central coast over the coming days, creating dangerous surf and rip current conditions. Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico's west-central Pacific coast on Sunday. Last week, Hurricane Polo made landfall on the Baja California Peninsula as a Category 2 storm, toppling trees and utility poles, flooding streets and causing other property damage.

item.title: Rain washes out qualifying, puts Kyle Larson on pole at Charlotte
item.description: CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CONCORD, N.C. -- Persistent rain forced cancellation or postponement of all NASCAR on-track activity on Saturday at Charlotte Motor Speedway. The cancellation of qualifying for the NASCAR Cup Series race puts Kyle Larson on the pole for Sunday's Bank of America 400, the sixth race in the Chase presented by Mobil 1 (3 p.m. ET on USA, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio). In addition, the Blue Cross NC 300 NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series race, scheduled for Saturday afternoon, has been postponed until 8 p.m. ET on Sunday night, following the Bank of America 400. The Blue Cross NC 300 will be broadcast on CW, PRN and SiriusXM NASCAR Radio. With the starting order set by a metric formula that combines the results of the previous race with owner points position, Larson, the Chase leader by 40 points over second-place Denny Hamlin, will start beside Chase Briscoe, last Sunday's winner at Las Vegas Motor Speedway. However, the driver of the No. 5 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet doesn't feel the top starting spot will give him as big an advantage as starting on the front row for the third Chase race at Kansas Speedway, where he started second and took control of the race. "I actually think (Charlotte) is a harder track to maintain a lead, because the grip in the surface is a lot less," Larson said. "At Kansas, you can maintain the lead pretty easily for three quarters of the run, and then they start coming at you. "From the (Coca-Cola) 600 (at Charlotte in May), I got out to a lead a couple of different times. I guess cars were just faster and passed me with no problem. ... But, yeah, if our car is good, we're going to try our best to get the lead and maintain it." Christopher Bell, third in the standings and 55 points behind Larson, starts 17th after a power steering failure at Las Vegas. Fourth-place Joey Logano, 71 points back, is seventh on the grid beside fellow Chase driver Bubba Wallace. Hamlin will take the green flag from the 12th position. Saturday's qualifying for the O'Reilly Series race also was canceled, leaving Chase driver Carson Kvapil on the pole with Las Vegas winner Corey Day beside him. Defending series champion Jesse Love starts third beside rookie Brent Crews. Series leader Sheldon Creed is eighth on the grid. --By Reid Spencer, NASCAR Wire Service

item.title: Motor racing Mercedes' Antonelli says car 'in a better place' but Russell takes 'step backwards'
item.description: Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Kimi Antonelli said Mercedes have got to the bottom of the issues on the new upgrade on his car after he qualified fourth-fastest on Saturday in Singapore, but George Russell feels he has taken a "step backwards" after a crash in the sprint. Formula One championship leader Antonelli, who leads Russell by 89 points, is looking to become the youngest ever world champion at 20 and will line up behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen and the Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton. Antonelli said he and the team are beginning to come to grips with a new upgrade package that was introduced in Sepang -- where he finished second -- while Russell reverted to an older setup that helped him win in Baku last month. "It definitely felt in a better place today, even though the window is very small where the car operates," Antonelli said after Saturday's qualifying session. "The team did a really good job because, first of all, we found the issues. Now we're able to understand more of the package and now it's more about trying to find the right window with the setup to make sure that the package works at its best. "Let's see what we can do from P4 but a podium will be very good." 'TWO TEST PILOTS' Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff had said on Friday that it had been tricky to assess the upgrade package over consecutive race weekends, with the team running "two test pilots" on the Marina Bay Street Circuit to weigh up the upgrade's value. "On Kimi's side the updates seem to have worked now," Wolff said. "He and his engineers have dialled out the problems and we got closer and closer. We're missing a tenth and a half or two-tenths, and that is, at least for qualifying, positive. "It will take some more proof of concept until I'm feeling warm and fuzzy. But we will have more data tomorrow, in the race, whether we can have less degradation." Wolff, who on Friday had dismissed suggestions of favouritism within the Mercedes team, said Russell had made a rare mistake to spin out of the lead in the sprint, reminiscent of a last-lap crash at Singapore in 2023 that cost him a shot at victory. Russell, who was sixth-fastest in Q3 but is set to start at the back of the grid due to an engine penalty, said he used the qualifying session to test whether his car was in working order after retiring from the sprint. "Something was a bit odd because we had great pace yesterday, and Kimi's in a similar position to where he was yesterday," Russell said. "But I've taken a step backwards and the car didn't feel quite the same... It'll be tough racing (tomorrow)."

item.title: Papa Leão condena pena de morte enquanto Trump pondera execução transmitida ao vivo
item.description: O papa Leão 14 renovou sua condenação à pena de morte, neste sábado, afirmando que ela viola a santidade da vida humana e priva as pessoas da chance de redenção, dias depois de o Pentágono anunciar que planeja transmitir ao vivo uma execução.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão 14 renovou sua condenação à pena de morte, neste sábado, afirmando que ela viola a santidade da vida humana e priva as pessoas da chance de redenção, dias depois de o Pentágono anunciar que planeja transmitir ao vivo uma execução. As Forças Armadas dos EUA transmitirão ao vivo execução por fuzilamento de um atirador que matou 13 pessoas na base militar de Fort Hood em 2009, afirmou o secretário de Defesa, Pete Hegseth, na quinta-feira, no que seria uma transmissão sem precedentes de uma execução nos EUA. “O bem comum pode ser salvaguardado e os requisitos da justiça podem ser atendidos sem recorrer à pena capital”, afirmou Leão, o primeiro papa dos Estados Unidos, em uma postagem nas redes sociais, sem mencionar o plano do Pentágono. “A pena de morte é inadmissível porque constitui um ataque à inviolabilidade e à dignidade da pessoa”, acrescentou ele na mensagem publicada no Dia Mundial contra a Pena de Morte. Nidal Hasan, um ex-psiquiatra do Exército, deve se tornar a primeira pessoa a ser executada por um pelotão de fuzilamento pelas Forças Armadas dos EUA desde 1945. O plano de transmissão ao vivo, defendido por Hegseth, gerou oposição de parlamentares, inclusive dos colegas republicanos do presidente Donald Trump, de líderes religiosos e de observadores internacionais. O próprio Trump afirmou que ainda não decidiu se permitirá a transmissão ao vivo, enquanto o vice-presidente JD Vance, que é católico, expressou ceticismo quanto à possibilidade de o Pentágono prosseguir com a transmissão ao vivo da execução marcada para 3 de dezembro. Vance também disse que não assistiria à transmissão ao vivo caso ela ocorresse. O plano de execução surge em meio a um debate acirrado nos EUA sobre a pena de morte, após uma injeção letal mal executada em uma mulher do Tennessee na semana passada.

item.title: Report: Cards finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
item.description: The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade former first-round draft pick Marvin Harrison Jr., NFL Network and ESPN reported Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Arizona Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade former first-round draft pick Marvin Harrison Jr., NFL Network and ESPN reported Saturday. The trade destination and the return for the third-year wide receiver were not reported. Harrison has been informed of the trade and will be inactive for Sunday's game against the visiting Detroit Lions as the deal is finalized, per the report. The NFL trade deadline is Nov. 10. Trade speculation heated up after Harrison, who previously did not have a representative, hired agents Todd France and Tory Dandy on Sept. 23. Harrison, 24, the No. 4 pick in the 2024 NFL Draft, has just five catches for 85 yards and one touchdown in four games (four starts) this season for the Cardinals (1-3). The son of Pro Football Hall of Fame wideout Marvin Harrison has recorded 108 career receptions (on 202 targets) for 1,578 yards and 13 touchdowns in 33 games (30 starts). He recorded 885 yards as a rookie in 17 games (16 starts) in 2004 and 608 in 12 games last season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Warriors signing G Brandin Podziemski to $110M extension
item.description: The Golden State Warriors have agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension with guard Brandin Podziemski.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Golden State Warriors have agreed to a five-year, $110 million extension with guard Brandin Podziemski. Agent Bill Duffy confirmed the details to ESPN on Saturday. His client avoided restricted free agency next summer. The deal with Podziemski, 23, is fully guaranteed and includes a mutual option for the final season in 2031-32. After earning $5.6 million in the final year of his rookie deal in 2026-27, he will earn $18.9 million next season. Podziemski averaged 13.8 points, 5.1 rebounds and 3.7 assists while playing all 82 games (43 starts) last season. He shot 37.1% from behind the arc and his 153 made 3-pointers were second on the team to Stephen Curry's 190. Since being drafted in the first round (19th overall) in 2023, Podziemski has averaged 11.6 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 220 games (104 starts) with Golden State. The Warriors open the regular season on the road against the Los Angeles Lakers on Oct. 21. --Field Level Media

item.title: Grizzlies C Isaiah Stewart out 2 weeks with ankle sprain
item.description: Memphis Grizzlies center Isaiah Stewart will miss the regular-season opener with an ankle injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Memphis Grizzlies center Isaiah Stewart will miss the regular-season opener with an ankle injury. The team announced Friday that Stewart has a moderate left ankle sprain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks. The Grizzlies tip off the season at home against the Utah Jazz on Oct. 21. The timeline means he could be available for the second game on Oct. 23 against the host Golden State Warriors. Stewart, 25, sustained the injury in the first quarter of Monday's preseason opener against the host Atlanta Hawks. Memphis acquired Stewart and the remainder of his four-year, $60 million contract during an offseason trade with the Detroit Pistons. He has a base salary of $15 million for this season and a $15 million team option in 2027-28. He averaged 10.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, a career-high 1.6 blocks and 22.7 minutes in 58 games (13 starts) last season with the Pistons. Stewart has career averages of 8.8 points and 6.8 boards in 365 games (194 starts) with Detroit. Stewart has been suspended five times by the NBA, most recently last February for seven games for leaving the bench during a brawl between the Pistons and Charlotte Hornets. The Portland Trail Blazers selected Stewart with the 16th overall pick in the 2020 NBA Draft and soon traded him to Detroit, where he made the NBA All-Rookie second team in 2020-21. --Field Level Media

item.title: OMS: Rússia confirmou morte em laboratório e disse que não foi registrado caso de peste
item.description: A Organização Mundial da Saúde informou no sábado que o órgão regulador de saúde da Rússia confirmou a morte de uma funcionária de laboratório em um centro de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria e comunicou à OMS que nenhum caso de peste havia sido registrado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Organização Mundial da Saúde informou no sábado que o órgão regulador de saúde da Rússia confirmou a morte de uma funcionária de laboratório em um centro de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria e comunicou à OMS que nenhum caso de peste havia sido registrado. Uma funcionária de laboratório de um instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria adoeceu e morreu em circunstâncias não divulgadas no dia 2 de outubro, levando as autoridades a colocar cerca de 200 pessoas em quarentena e causando temores em relação à saúde pública nas redes sociais.

item.title: Léon XIV condamne la peine de mort, alors que Trump envisage de diffuser une exécution en direct
item.description: Le pape Léon XIV a réitéré samedi sa condamnation de la peine de mort, soulignant qu'elle portait atteinte au caractère sacré de la vie humaine et privait les personnes de toute chance de rédemption, quelques jours après que le Pentagone a annoncé son intention de diffuser une exécution en direct.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le pape Léon XIV a réitéré samedi sa condamnation de la peine de mort, soulignant qu'elle portait atteinte au caractère sacré de la vie humaine et privait les personnes de toute chance de rédemption, quelques jours après que le Pentagone a annoncé son intention de diffuser une exécution en direct. L'armée américaine a prévu de retransmettre en direct l'exécution de Nidal Hasan, qui avait tué 13 personnes sur la base militaire de Fort Hood au Texas en 2009, ce qui serait sans précédent aux Etats-Unis. "Il est possible de préserver le bien commun et de répondre aux exigences de la justice sans recourir à la peine capitale : des systèmes de détention efficaces ont été mis en place, qui protègent les citoyens tout en ne privant pas totalement les coupables de la possibilité d'une rédemption", a déclaré Léon XIV, premier pape originaire des États-Unis, dans un message sur les réseaux sociaux. "La peine de mort est inadmissible car elle porte atteinte à l'inviolabilité et à la dignité de la personne", a-t-il ajouté dans cette déclaration, publiée à l'occasion de la Journée mondiale contre la peine de mort et qui ne fait pas explicitement référence au projet du Pentagone. Nidal Hasan, un ancien psychiatre de l'armée de terre condamné à mort en 2013 par un tribunal militaire, doit être fusillé par un peloton d'exécution le 3 décembre. L'armée américaine n'a pas eu recours au peloton d'exécution pour un condamné à mort depuis 1945, peu après la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Le projet de diffusion en direct de l'exécution, défendu par le secrétaire à la Défense Pete Hegseth, a été critiqué par certains élus républicains et stratèges conservateurs, de même que par des chefs religieux et des observateurs internationaux. Donald Trump a dit "approuver absolument" l'exécution mais ne pas avoir encore pris de décision sur la diffusion en direct. Le vice-président J.D. Vance a pour sa part déclaré qu'il ignorait si l'exécution serait bel et bien retransmise mais que, si tel était le cas, il ne la regarderait pas. Ce projet intervient dans un contexte de débat intense sur la peine de mort aux États-Unis, à la suite de l'injection létale ratée d'une femme dans le Tennessee, la semaine dernière.

item.title: Australia's Renshaw savours redemption after decade-long wait for second test ton
item.description: Matt Renshaw's imperious 190 for Australia put the visitors in the driving seat on day two of the first test against South Africa in Durban on Saturday and provided redemption after he wondered if his chance to play test cricket again had gone.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Matt Renshaw's imperious 190 for Australia put the visitors in the driving seat [USN:L1N45W02Z TEXT:"on day two"] of the first test against South Africa in Durban on Saturday and provided redemption after he wondered if his chance to play test cricket again had gone. Renshaw’s career-best score helped Australia recover from 124 for six to make 390 in their first innings and comes almost 10 years after his only other test century against Pakistan. "I never thought I'd be here this long," the 30-year-old said. "I think once I took a few years out of the team, and had an opportunity in 2023 and didn't take it, you probably think that you're never going to get this opportunity again. "When I hit the ball (for a century), I was screaming at it, ‘Go, go, go!’ And it just hit me at once. And Nathan (Lyon) at the other end is pretty emotional. So to see that, it was pretty special." Renshaw had scored single figures in 11 of his previous 13 test innings before this one dating back nine years. "I always wanted that second one (century). I had the monkey off my back early with that first one but, for me, this one was about all the stuff that has come in the last 10 years. All the hard work, all the failures, all the success." Renshaw believes the lows in his career provided valuable experience in Durban. "All the stuff that I've done in the past 10 years has probably led me to this moment. I wouldn't be where I was without all the failures," he said. "We're quick to judge failures, but I think some of the best learning has come from failures. "I felt calm at times. I didn't probably look calm but I think everything led up to this and culminated in this innings." With South Africa 27 for one in reply and trailing by 363, Renshaw expects the wicket to get trickier to bat on. "It probably got a little bit slower," he said. "There were a few balls where there was a fair bit of spin. A few went low. And I think with the new ball, you saw there was a little bit of movement around."

item.title: WHO unsure what caused pneumonia that killed plague-lab worker in Russia
item.description: The World Health Organization said on Saturday that it still does not know what caused the pneumonia that killed a Russian lab worker at an anti-plague research center in Siberia this month, and that no case of plague had been registered.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The World Health Organization said on Saturday that it still does not know what caused the pneumonia that killed a Russian lab worker at an anti-plague research center in Siberia this month, and that no case of plague had been registered. The WHO said the Russian state regulator reported that tests of the lab worker and those who came in contact with her were negative for the high-threat pathogens tested, that her contacts still showed no symptoms, and that no further linked cases of severe pneumonia had been identified. "Based on the information provided ... (the) WHO has not identified evidence of ongoing transmission associated with this event. A key uncertainty remains the absence of a confirmed diagnosis in the deceased laboratory worker," it said in a statement. The lab worker [USN:L1N45S0CY TEXT:"fell ill"] and died in undisclosed circumstances on October 2, prompting authorities to quarantine about 200 people and causing public health fears on social media. Global health officials have been extra alert to fatal pneumonia cases of undetermined cause since the COVID-19 pandemic, which began with a cluster of fast-spreading fatal respiratory illness in China. The cause of individual pneumonia cases can often not be determined. Russian authorities have said the lab worker was appropriately vaccinated and that they found no microorganisms linked to her work in her body. On Thursday, Russia said it had completed health checks on all the worker's contacts. It says it had provided full information to the WHO according to established procedures.

item.title: Pope Leo condemns death penalty as Trump mulls livestreamed execution
item.description: Pope Leo renewed his condemnation of the death penalty on Saturday, saying it violates the sanctity of human life and deprives people of the chance of redemption, days after the Pentagon said it planned to livestream an execution.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo renewed his condemnation of the death penalty on Saturday, saying it violates the sanctity of human life and deprives people of the chance of redemption, days after the Pentagon said it planned to [USN:L1N45U124 TEXT:"livestream an execution"]. The US military will livestream the upcoming firing squad execution of a gunman who killed 13 people at the Fort Hood military base in 2009, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday, in what would be an unprecedented broadcast of a US execution. "The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment," Leo, the first pope from the United States, said in a social media post, without mentioning the Pentagon plan. "The death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person," he added in the message posted on the World Day Against the Death Penalty. Nidal Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945. The livestream plan, championed by Hegseth, has [USN:L6N45V11B TEXT:"drawn opposition"] from lawmakers, including from President Donald Trump's Republicans, religious leaders and international observers. Trump himself has said he has not yet decided whether to allow the live feed, while Vice President JD Vance, who is a Catholic, expressed scepticism over whether the Pentagon would proceed with livestreaming the scheduled December 3 execution. Vance also said he would not watch the livestream if it went ahead. The execution plan comes amid heightened debate in the US over the death penalty following a [USN:L1N45S11A TEXT:"botched lethal injection"] of a Tennessee woman last week.

item.title: Ex-Virginia star Heidi Burge Horton dies from brain cancer
item.description: Former Virginia standout and WNBA player Heidi Burge Horton died on Oct. 5 after battling brain cancer. She was 54.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Virginia standout and WNBA player Heidi Burge Horton died on Oct. 5 after battling brain cancer. She was 54. "We are deeply saddened by the passing of Heidi Burge Horton," the school posted this week. "Heidi was a cherished member of the Virginia Women's Basketball family, her legacy will forever be a part of Virginia Athletics. Our sincere condolences to her family and loved ones." The 6-foot-5 Burge Horton played alongside her identical twin sister, Heather Burge, for four seasons and helped to establish the Cavaliers as a national powerhouse along with All-America teammate Dawn Staley. "We are all heartbroken!" Staley, now the coach at South Carolina, posted on X. "We love you Heidi. May your soul rest in peace and your body pain free." Virginia reached the Final Four in each of Burge Horton's first three seasons in 1989-90, 1990-91 and 1991-92, losing 70-67 to Tennessee in the 1991 national championship game in New Orleans. Burge Horton averaged 8.9 points and 6.4 rebounds in 134 games with the Cavaliers from 1989-93 before playing overseas in France, Hungary, Italy and Greece. The California native later played two seasons in the WNBA with the Los Angeles Sparks in the league's inaugural season in 1997 and with the expansion Washington Mystics in 1998, averaging 5.5 points and 3.3 rebounds in 52 games (21 starts). The Disney Channel released a movie about the Burge twins called "Double Teamed" in 2002. --Field Level Media

item.title: Canadiens trade D Jayden Struble to Predators for draft pick
item.description: The Nashville Predators acquired defenseman Jayden Struble from the Montreal Canadiens for a second-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Nashville Predators acquired defenseman Jayden Struble from the Montreal Canadiens for a second-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft. Struble, 25, played in three games this season for Montreal, averaging a career-low 12:05 of ice time with no points. The Rhode Island native has 35 points (seven goals, 28 assists), a plus-3 rating and 167 penalty minutes in 174 games since making his NHL debut with the Canadiens in 2023. Montreal drafted Struble in the second round in 2019. "Jayden Struble is a 25-year-old physical defender who will add mobility and a hard-to-play-against quality that will help our backend," said Chris MacFarland, the Predators' president of hockey operations and general manager, on Friday. "We are excited to watch his growth and look forward to him being a player who can grow with us." Struble is in the second season of a two-year, $2.825 million contract he signed with the Canadiens on July 28, 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Vários ficam feridos em explosão no aeroporto de Riad, segundo testemunhas
item.description: Muitas pessoas ficaram feridas em uma explosão no aeroporto internacional de Riad no sábado, segundo duas testemunhas oculares e duas pessoas a par do assunto, e os viajantes foram retirados de algumas áreas do local.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Enas Alashray
item.content:encoded: Muitas pessoas ficaram feridas em uma explosão no aeroporto internacional de Riad no sábado, segundo duas testemunhas oculares e duas pessoas a par do assunto, e os viajantes foram retirados de algumas áreas do local. Uma das testemunhas relatou ter visto uma explosão e, em seguida, várias pessoas feridas caídas no chão dentro do aeroporto. Mais de uma dezena de ambulâncias foram vistas se dirigindo às pressas para o aeroporto. A assessoria de imprensa do governo saudita e a autoridade de aviação civil saudita não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentários. O incidente de sábado ocorre em meio a uma escalada de ataques com mísseis contra o reino por parte dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados com o Irã. O aeroporto já havia sido atacado duas vezes nesta semana, deixando quatro mortos e outros feridos, além de causar graves danos a uma aeronave. O site de rastreamento de voos flightradar24 mostrou que todos os voos com destino a Riad haviam sido desviados ou cancelados, com apenas um helicóptero sobrevoando o aeroporto em determinado momento. O aeroporto pediu aos passageiros que entrassem em contato diretamente com suas companhias aéreas e verificassem o status de seus voos antes de se dirigirem ao local. A Kuwait Airways informou ter cancelado voos de e para a capital saudita devido ao que descreveu como o fechamento do aeroporto de Riad por causa da “situação de segurança” no local. A Etihad Airways e a Catar Airways já haviam cancelado vários voos entre seus respectivos hubs e Riad, com alguns cancelamentos se estendendo até segunda-feira.

item.title: L'Érythrée demande à l'Onu d'intervenir dans son conflit avec l'Éthiopie
item.description: L'Érythrée a demandé samedi au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de prendre des mesures dissuasives à l'encontre de l'Éthiopie, selon une lettre consultée par Reuters, faisant valoir que les accusations d'incursion formulées par Addis-Abeba à son encontre équivalaient à une "déclaration de guerre".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Érythrée a demandé samedi au Conseil de sécurité de l'Onu de prendre des mesures dissuasives à l'encontre de l'Éthiopie, selon une lettre consultée par Reuters, faisant valoir que les accusations d'incursion formulées par Addis-Abeba à son encontre équivalaient à une "déclaration de guerre". Cette incursion, démentie par l'Érythrée et que Reuters n'a pas pu vérifier de manière indépendante, fait craindre un retour à une guerre ouverte le long de la frontière nord de l'Éthiopie, où ces deux pays voisins de la Corne de l'Afrique se sont déjà affrontés par le passé. Les conflits ailleurs dans la région et les tensions de l'autre côté de la mer Rouge accroissent encore les enjeux de ce conflit.
